sites.name: Po Klong Garai Towers
sites.event: The most majestic and beautiful remaining Cham tower complex in Vietnam, dedicated to King Po Klong Garai - the king who made great contributions to digging canals and building irrigation dams.

sites.name: Vinh Hy Bay
sites.event: Known as one of the 4 most beautiful bays in Vietnam, famous for its coastal pass road and glass-bottom boat coral viewing.

sites.name: Bau Truc Pottery Village
sites.event: The oldest pottery village in Southeast Asia, famous for its 'hand-shaped, foot-turned' manual pottery technique (without using a potter's wheel), inscribed by UNESCO as an Intangible Cultural Heritage.

sites.name: Hang Rai
sites.event: A natural masterpiece with a million-year-old ancient coral reef and a unique 'waterfall on the sea' phenomenon when waves crash.

sites.name: Nam Cuong Sand Dunes
sites.event: Pristine red sand dunes, likened to a miniature desert, where visitors can observe the daily life of the Cham people.

sites.name: Mui Dinh (Mui Dinh Lighthouse)
sites.event: Home to an ancient lighthouse built in 1904 by the French and the stunningly pristine Trang Beach.

sites.name: Nui Chua National Park
sites.event: A world biosphere reserve, characterized by a unique dry forest ecosystem rarely seen in Vietnam.

sites.name: An Hoa Sheep Farm
sites.event: The largest sheep grazing field in Ninh Thuan, imbued with a nomadic style amidst the sunny and windy land.

sites.name: Hoa Lai Towers (Ba Thap)
sites.event: An ancient Cham tower relic complex built in the 9th century, featuring the characteristic Hoa Lai architectural style.

sites.name: My Nghiep Weaving Village
sites.event: A long-standing traditional brocade weaving village of the Cham people, preserving unique patterns.

sites.name: Ba Moi Vineyard
sites.event: A famous vineyard, a pioneer in the agricultural eco-tourism model in Ninh Thuan.
